coverage_gaps_basis: consecutive daily points more than 3 days apart; no prices were observed inside a gap and none are interpolated
observations_basis: every central-series row in the trailing 7 days, NOT downsampled (`entries` is the daily series). timestamp is when PegTracker wrote the row; the feed's own update time is not stored per row. chain/source/feed are stamped from observation_provenance, and only on rows at or after its `since`.
